comments.body:
**Reviewed and strengthened the proof of rm-00332.**

**What I verified (exact arithmetic, all primes p up to 200; n up to 200 for (v)):**
- Exact algebraic identity (mod p^2): Sigma_1 = S_0 + 3 S_1, where Sigma_1 = sum_{k<p} (3k+1)C(2k,k)^3/16^k.
- Mod-p^2 shadow: Sigma_1 ≡ p (mod p^2)  [in fact ≡ p mod p^3, the corrections being killed by integrality of B_{p-3}, E_{p-3}].
- (i.1): S_0 ≡ 4x^2 - 2p (mod p^2)  — CORRECT.
- (i.2) AS PRINTED: S_1 ≡ (p-4x^2)/3 — FALSE for every p ≡ 1 mod 6.  Correct form: S_1 ≡ (3p-4x^2)/3 (mod p^2), off by exactly 2p/3.
- (ii): S_0 ≡ 0 and S_1 ≡ p/3 (mod p^2) — both correct (deduced from the linking identity).

**Key improvement — airtight, non-circular refutation.**
The previous draft refuted (i.2) by 'substituting into the linking relation', which obscured a potential circularity. I recast the refutation in the cleanest logically-forced way:

> If BOTH printed congruences of (i) held, then by the EXACT identity Sigma_1 = S_0 + 3 S_1 we would get
>   Sigma_1 ≡ (4x^2 - 2p) + 3·(p-4x^2)/3 = -p (mod p^2),
> contradicting the established shadow Sigma_1 ≡ +p (mod p^2). Hence p ≡ -p, i.e. p | 2 — absurd.

Since (i.1) is a genuine theorem of Sun (verified), it is the printed (i.2) that fails. Crucially, the shadow Sigma_1 ≡ p (mod p^2) is a statement about the COMBINATION S_0+3S_1, independent of (i.1)/(i.2) individually, so the argument is not circular. I added an explicit 'Logical map' and an 'Independence/non-circularity' remark.

**On self-containedness of the shadow.** I attempted an elementary Gosper/WZ telescoping of the partial sums to prove Sigma_1 ≡ p directly; I proved (via sympy) that NO rational certificate R with denominators (2k-1), (2k-1)^2 and numerator degree ≤ 4 satisfies the telescoping equation R(k+1)(2k+1)^3/(k+1)^3 − R(k) = 3k+1. This matches the well-known absence of a hypergeometric closed form for these Ramanujan-type truncations, so the mod-p^2 shadow is genuinely a (mild) cited supercongruence of Sun; documented honestly in a remark.

**Status of the five parts (now rigorously framed):**
- (i.1): proved (= cited Sun evaluation of S_0; verified).
- (i.2): REFUTED as printed; corrected to (3p-4x^2)/3.
- (ii): proved in full from the linking identity + cited S_0 evaluation.
- (iii),(iv),(v): cited theorems of Z.-W. Sun; elementary scaffolding (tail-vanishing Lemma 1, exact linear identity, U_n/W_n recurrences) proved in full, with the precise reduction made explicit and all numerics certified on the stated ranges.

solution.tex updated. Honest bottom line: the problem statement's (i.2) is incorrect (off by 2p/3); everything else is established, with parts (iii)-(v) relying on cited Sun supercongruences whose fully self-contained proofs are out of scope of a short treatment.
